title: SunshinePHP 2020
content:
In February 2020 come to Miami, Florida and escape the cold to learn more about PHP and speak with other developers, like you, to see what others are doing. The has been announced, and we've assembled a great line-up with the most current PHP related topics for you.SunshinePHP 2020 speaker list
